observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection over authenticated Store session events

outcome.interpretation: Three authenticated campaign-state read failures in one session, before its first campaign-state checkpoint, form an investigation candidate about first-use initialization and guidance. A later read succeeded after state was initialized, but the event sequence does not establish that the code change caused that success or that all three failures had the same underlying cause.
outcome.analysis_limit: The evidence covers one session and one bounded event window. It does not establish recurrence across sessions, the root cause of each provider failure, or the effect of a later implementation change.

pressure_hypothesis.title: First campaign-state reads need discoverable initialization guidance
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment campaign-state initialization and CLI guidance
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Three authenticated failures for campaign.state with failure code campaign-state-unavailable appear before the first campaign-state checkpoint in one session.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When campaign-state history is absent, expose the exact first-checkpoint initialization fields and the next command so an agent can establish continuity and retry.
not_measured: whether the same limitation occurs in independent sessions
whether all three failures share one underlying cause
whether later success was caused by the diagnostic change rather than state initialization
agent time, token use, or resource impact
root cause and appropriateness of each historical campaign-state failure
whether the improvement changes future first-use outcomes
